name: TDEX
recent: TDEX 正在推进最多 10% 已发行股份的私募配售，并已获 Bursa Securities 批准将完成期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 4 月 27 日。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 10 日召开第 22 届常年股东大会，同时与 Gurun Power Generation 的经常性关联交易金额已超过集团净资产的 1%。
notable: Bursa Securities 批准私募配售完成期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 4 月 27 日。
与 Gurun Power Generation 的经常性关联交易金额超过集团净资产的 1%。
risks: 私募配售最多 10% 新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
公司需在 2027 年 4 月 27 日前完成私募配售，否则批准可能失效。

recent_en: TDEX is proceeding with a private placement of up to 10% of its issued shares and has obtained Bursa Securities' approval for a 6-month extension to complete it by 27 April 2027.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% of issued shares at an issue price to be determined later.
Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension to complete the private placement by 27 April 2027.
Recurrent related party transactions with Gurun Power Generation exceeded 1% of the group's net assets.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
The company needs to complete the private placement by 27 April 2027, failing which the approval may lapse.
